headline: 今天的主线：代理开始自己出画面。有人做无头三维引擎，有人让编程代理把片子逐帧写成代码，也有人用技能直接出短视频动画。
headlineEn: Today's thread: agents are starting to make the picture themselves. One built a headless 3D engine, another has a coding agent write each frame, and a third ships skills that render short animations.

lead.name: voyager-so/vork
lead.zh: 给代理用的无头三维和特效引擎，仓库写明现在是研究预览。
lead.en: A headless 3D and effects engine meant for agents. The repo calls the current release a research preview.
lead.why: 它不让模型只写分镜。README 里的样片是车开进夜里，树林被场景着色器画成青色线框，运动部分是渲染出来的。
lead.whyEn: It does not stop at a shot list. The README's sample is a car driving into night, with the forest drawn as a cyan wireframe by a scene shader, and the moving parts actually rendered.

items.name: sarpstar/cinecode
items.zh: 在 Claude Code 或 Cursor 里，让代理写剧本、用代码出每一帧，再交一个 MP4。
items.en: Inside Claude Code or Cursor, an agent writes the script, builds each frame in code, and hands back an MP4.

items.name: artemnovitckii/claude-animation-skills
items.zh: 六个 Claude Code 技能，不用素材就能出短视频动画，例如输入路线让它在本机渲染。
items.en: Six Claude Code skills that render short animations without footage, including a route you type and it renders locally.

items.name: benjitaylor/skills
items.zh: 给编程代理用的设计和动效技能，能搭仿产品界面，并拍下来让代理自己检查。
items.en: Design and motion skills for coding agents, including faux product UI that the agent can film and check.

items.name: Capnot
items.zh: 上架文案只说一件事：静音时也要让屏幕演示看得清。
items.en: The listing says one thing: screen demos should stay clear even when muted.

items.name: Sequence Tool
items.zh: 用改文字的方式剪长录像，介绍里说最后得到整理过的故事。
items.en: The listing says you edit long recordings by changing the words, and end up with a polished story.

items.name: chutingyean/Agent-Cockpit
items.zh: 本地白板加 MCP：每个结论要能追到那次运行和它依赖的代码，断了卡片会变红。
items.en: A local whiteboard plus MCP. Each claim has to trace to the run and the code it used, and a broken link turns the card red.

items.name: EricJujianZou/rederive
items.zh: 一个编程代理技能：只提问，不讲解，让你自己把代码库的设计决定重新推一遍。
items.en: A coding-agent skill that only asks questions. It will not explain, so you re-derive the codebase's design decisions yourself.

items.name: wangzan101/Mika
items.zh: 安卓上的本地代理。你说要做什么，它在后台屏幕里操作应用和网页，前台还能继续用手机。
items.en: An on-device Android agent. You say the task, and it works apps and the web on a hidden screen while you keep using the phone.

items.name: Exa Monitors v2
items.zh: 介绍写的是定时网页搜索，到点去叫你的代理，标价是每千次运行 2 美元。
items.en: The listing describes scheduled web search that calls your agent, priced at $2 per thousand runs.
